# JAIDE-V31 Hardware Backend in BQN
# Provides low-level compute primitives for KAN operations

# Matrix multiplication using blocked algorithm
MatMul ← {
  𝕨 (≢𝕨) {
    a‿b←𝕨⋄m‿k←≢a⋄k‿n←≢b
    blockSize←64
    {
      iBlock←𝕩
      i←iBlock×blockSize
      iEnd←(i+blockSize)⌊m
      {
        jBlock←𝕩
        j←jBlock×blockSize
        jEnd←(j+blockSize)⌊n
        {
          kBlock←𝕩
          kIdx←kBlock×blockSize
          kEnd←(kIdx+blockSize)⌊k
          aBlock←(i+↕iEnd-i)⊏a
          aBlock↩(kIdx+↕kEnd-kIdx)⊸⊏˘aBlock
          bBlock←(kIdx+↕kEnd-kIdx)⊏b
          bBlock↩(j+↕jEnd-j)⊸⊏˘bBlock
          +˝˘aBlock×⎉1‿∞bBlock
        }¨↕⌈k÷blockSize
      }¨↕⌈n÷blockSize
    }¨↕⌈m÷blockSize
  } 𝕩
}

# Kolmogorov-Arnold spline basis evaluation
KANSplineBasis ← {
  x‿knots‿degree←𝕩
  n←≢knots
  k←degree
  
  # Initialize basis functions
  basis←(n-1-k)⥊0
  
  # Cox-de Boor recursion
  {
    d←𝕩
    {
      i←𝕩
      left←(i⊑knots)
      right←((i+d+1)⊑knots)
      span←right-left
      (span>0)◶{
        0
      }‿{
        w1←(x-left)÷span
        w2←1-w1
        (w1×(i⊑basis))+(w2×((i+1)⊑basis))
      }@
    }¨↕n-d-1
  }´⌽1+↕k
  
  basis
}

# Grid computation for spline coefficients
KANGridCompute ← {
  input‿gridSize‿degree←𝕩
  batchSize‿inputDim←≢input
  
  # Generate uniform knot vector
  knots←(-degree+↕gridSize+2×degree)÷gridSize-1+degree
  
  # Compute basis for each input dimension
  {
    batch←𝕩
    {
      dim←𝕩
      x←batch⊑input⋄x↩dim⊑x
      KANSplineBasis x‿knots‿degree
    }¨↕inputDim
  }¨↕batchSize
}

# Geometric algebra operations
GAMultivectorProduct ← {
  a‿b←𝕩
  # Extract components (scalar, vector, bivector, trivector, pseudoscalar)
  as‿av‿abv‿atv‿aps←a
  bs‿bv‿bbv‿btv‿bps←b
  
  # Geometric product computation
  scalar←(as×bs)-(+´av×bv)
  vector←(as×bv)+(bs×av)+(av⊸CrossProduct bv)
  bivector←(as×bbv)+(bs×abv)+(av⊸WedgeProduct bv)
  trivector←(as×btv)+(bs×atv)
  pseudoscalar←(as×bps)+(bs×aps)
  
  scalar‿vector‿bivector‿trivector‿pseudoscalar
}

CrossProduct ← {
  a‿b←𝕩
  ((1⊑a)×(2⊑b))-(2⊑a)×(1⊑b)‿
  ((2⊑a)×(0⊑b))-(0⊑a)×(2⊑b)‿
  ((0⊑a)×(1⊑b))-(1⊑a)×(0⊑b)
}

WedgeProduct ← {
  a‿b←𝕩
  n←≢a
  {
    i←𝕩
    {
      j←𝕩
      (j>i)◶{0}‿{((i⊑a)×(j⊑b))-((j⊑a)×(i⊑b))}@
    }¨↕n
  }¨↕n
}

InnerProduct ← {
  a‿b←𝕩
  as‿av‿abv‿atv‿aps←a
  bs‿bv‿bbv‿btv‿bps←b
  (as×bs)+(+´av×bv)
}

# Quantum circuit simulation primitives
QuantumStateInit ← {
  nQubits←𝕩
  stateSize←2⋆nQubits
  amplitudes←stateSize⥊0‿0  # Real and imaginary parts
  amplitudes↩1‿0⌾(0⊸⊑)amplitudes  # |0⟩ state
  amplitudes
}

ApplyHadamard ← {
  state‿qubit←𝕩
  nQubits←2⋆⁼≢state
  qubitMask←2⋆qubit
  sqrt2Inv←÷√2
  
  {
    i←𝕩
    i0←i∧¬qubitMask
    i1←i∨qubitMask
    amp0←i0⊑state
    amp1←i1⊑state
    
    (i∧qubitMask)◶{
      sqrt2Inv×(amp0+amp1)
    }‿{
      sqrt2Inv×(amp0-amp1)
    }@
  }¨↕≢state
}

ApplyPauliX ← {
  state‿qubit←𝕩
  qubitMask←2⋆qubit
  {
    i←𝕩
    flipped←i⊻qubitMask
    flipped⊑state
  }¨↕≢state
}

ApplyRotation ← {
  state‿qubit‿angle‿axis←𝕩
  cosHalf←•math.Cos angle÷2
  sinHalf←•math.Sin angle÷2
  qubitMask←2⋆qubit
  
  {
    i←𝕩
    i0←i∧¬qubitMask
    i1←i∨qubitMask
    amp0←i0⊑state
    amp1←i1⊑state
    
    axis◶{
      # Rotation X
      (i∧qubitMask)◶{
        (cosHalf×amp0)+(sinHalf×ComplexI×amp1)
      }‿{
        (sinHalf×ComplexI×amp0)+(cosHalf×amp1)
      }@
    }‿{
      # Rotation Y
      (i∧qubitMask)◶{
        (cosHalf×amp0)-(sinHalf×amp1)
      }‿{
        (sinHalf×amp0)+(cosHalf×amp1)
      }@
    }‿{
      # Rotation Z
      phase0←(•math.Cos -angle÷2)‿(•math.Sin -angle÷2)
      phase1←(•math.Cos angle÷2)‿(•math.Sin angle÷2)
      (i∧qubitMask)◶{
        ComplexMul amp0‿phase0
      }‿{
        ComplexMul amp1‿phase1
      }@
    }@
  }¨↕≢state
}

ComplexI ← 0‿1
ComplexMul ← {
  a‿b←𝕩
  ar‿ai←a⋄br‿bi←b
  (ar×br)-(ai×bi)‿(ar×bi)+(ai×br)
}

# Differential privacy noise generation
DPNoiseGeneration ← {
  shape‿epsilon‿sensitivity←𝕩
  scale←sensitivity÷epsilon
  # Laplace noise generation
  {
    u←(•rand.Range 1)-0.5
    scale×(-×⊢)•math.Log 1-2×|u
  }¨shape⥊0
}

# Memory-efficient attention computation
EfficientAttention ← {
  q‿k‿v‿blockSize←𝕩
  seqLen‿headDim←≢q
  numBlocks←⌈seqLen÷blockSize
  
  output←seqLen‿headDim⥊0
  
  {
    iBlock←𝕩
    iStart←iBlock×blockSize
    iEnd←(iStart+blockSize)⌊seqLen
    qBlock←(iStart+↕iEnd-iStart)⊏q
    
    scores←qBlock MatMul⍉k
    maxScores←⌈´˘scores
    expScores←•math.Exp scores-maxScores
    sumExpScores←+´˘expScores
    attnWeights←expScores÷sumExpScores
    
    blockOutput←attnWeights MatMul v
    output↩blockOutput⌾((iStart+↕iEnd-iStart)⊸⊏)output
  }¨↕numBlocks
  
  output
}

# Flash attention kernel
FlashAttention ← {
  q‿k‿v‿blockSize←𝕩
  batchSize‿numHeads‿seqLen‿headDim←≢q
  
  {
    batch←𝕩
    {
      head←𝕩
      qh←(batch⊑q)⊑head
      kh←(batch⊑k)⊑head
      vh←(batch⊑v)⊑head
      
      EfficientAttention qh‿kh‿vh‿blockSize
    }¨↕numHeads
  }¨↕batchSize
}

# Tensor contraction for KAN layers
TensorContract ← {
  a‿b‿indices←𝕩
  shapeA←≢a
  shapeB←≢b
  
  # Einstein summation implementation
  contractDims‿outputDimsA‿outputDimsB←indices
  
  resultShape←(contractDims⊏shapeA)∾(outputDimsB⊏shapeB)
  
  # Perform contraction
  {
    idx←𝕩
    aIndices←(outputDimsA⊑idx)∾(contractDims⊑idx)
    bIndices←(contractDims⊑idx)∾(outputDimsB⊑idx)
    +´(aIndices⊏a)×(bIndices⊏b)
  }¨resultShape⥊↕×´resultShape
}

# Specialized KAN forward pass
KANForward ← {
  input‿weights‿knots‿gridSize‿degree←𝕩
  batchSize‿inputDim←≢input
  outputDim←1⊑≢weights
  
  # Compute spline basis
  basis←KANGridCompute input‿gridSize‿degree
  
  # Apply learned coefficients
  {
    batch←𝕩
    basisBatch←batch⊑basis
    {
      outDim←𝕩
      weightsOut←outDim⊑weights
      +´{
        inDim←𝕩
        basisVec←inDim⊑basisBatch
        coeffs←inDim⊑weightsOut
        +´basisVec×coeffs
      }¨↕inputDim
    }¨↕outputDim
  }¨↕batchSize
}

# Parallel reduction for gradient aggregation
ParallelReduce ← {
  data‿operation←𝕩
  n←≢data
  
  # Binary tree reduction
  {
    level←𝕩
    stride←2⋆level
    {
      i←𝕩
      left←i⊑data
      right←(i+stride÷2)⊑data

    }¨(stride×↕⌊n÷stride)
  }´↕⌈2⋆⁼n
}

  end

  # Private Functions

  defp via_tuple(actor_id) do
    {:via, Registry, {JAIDE.ActorRegistry, actor_id}}
  end

  defp generate_actor_id do
    "actor_#{:erlang.unique_integer([:positive, :monotonic])}"
  end

  defp initialize_metrics do
    %{
      total_requests: 0,
      successful_requests: 0,
      failed_requests: 0,
      average_latency_us: 0.0,
      last_update: DateTime.utc_now(),
      throughput_per_sec: 0.0
    }
  end

  defp default_kan_config do
    %{

      output_dim: 512,
      grid_size: 8,
      spline_degree: 3,
      activation: :silu,
      use_base_activation: true,
      base_activation_scale: 1.0
    }
  end

  defp compute_kan_forward(input, state) do
    try do
      config = state.kan_config
      shard = state.model_shard
      
      # Step 1: Base activation
      base_output = if config.use_base_activation do
        apply_base_activation(input, config.activation, config.base_activation_scale)
      else
        input
      end
      
      # Step 2: Spline basis evaluation
      spline_output = compute_spline_basis(input, config.grid_size, config.spline_degree)
      
      # Step 3: Apply learned coefficients
      weighted_output = apply_spline_coefficients(spline_output, shard.coefficients)
      
      # Step 4: Combine base and spline outputs
      final_output = combine_outputs(base_output, weighted_output, shard.combination_weights)
      
      {:ok, final_output}
    rescue
      e -> {:error, Exception.message(e)}
    end
  end

  defp apply_base_activation(input, activation, scale) do
    Enum.map(input, fn x ->
      activated = case activation do
        :silu -> x / (1 + :math.exp(-x))  # SiLU/Swish
        :gelu -> 0.5 * x * (1 + :math.tanh(:math.sqrt(2 / :math.pi) * (x + 0.044715 * :math.pow(x, 3))))
        :relu -> max(0.0, x)
        :tanh -> :math.tanh(x)
        :sigmoid -> 1 / (1 + :math.exp(-x))
        _ -> x
      end
      activated * scale
    end)
  end

  defp compute_spline_basis(input, grid_size, degree) do
    knots = generate_uniform_knots(grid_size, degree)
    
    Enum.map(input, fn x ->
      evaluate_bspline_basis(x, knots, degree, grid_size)
    end)
  end

  defp generate_uniform_knots(grid_size, degree) do
    for i <- (-degree)..(grid_size + degree) do
      i / (grid_size - 1 + degree)
    end
  end

  defp evaluate_bspline_basis(x, knots, degree, grid_size) do
    n = length(knots)
    basis = List.duplicate(0.0, n - degree - 1)
    
    # Cox-de Boor recursion
    basis = initialize_basis(x, knots, basis)
    
    Enum.reduce(1..degree, basis, fn d, acc ->
      update_basis_recursion(x, knots, acc, d)
    end)
  end

  defp initialize_basis(x, knots, basis) do
    Enum.with_index(basis)
    |> Enum.map(fn {_, i} ->
      left = Enum.at(knots, i)
      right = Enum.at(knots, i + 1)
      
      if x >= left and x < right do
        1.0
      else
        0.0
      end
    end)
  end

  defp update_basis_recursion(x, knots, basis, degree) do
    n = length(basis) - degree
    
    for i <- 0..(n - 1) do
      left = Enum.at(knots, i)
      right = Enum.at(knots, i + degree + 1)
      span = right - left
      
      if span > 0 do
        w1 = (x - left) / span
        w2 = 1 - w1
        
        left_basis = Enum.at(basis, i, 0.0)
        right_basis = Enum.at(basis, i + 1, 0.0)
        
        w1 * left_basis + w2 * right_basis
      else
        0.0
      end
    end
  end

  defp apply_spline_coefficients(spline_basis, coefficients) do
    Enum.zip(spline_basis, coefficients)
    |> Enum.map(fn {basis_vec, coeff_matrix} ->
      matrix_vector_multiply(coeff_matrix, basis_vec)
    end)
    |> flatten_and_sum()
  end

  defp matrix_vector_multiply(matrix, vector) do
    Enum.map(matrix, fn row ->
      Enum.zip(row, vector)
      |> Enum.map(fn {a, b} -> a * b end)
      |> Enum.sum()
    end)
  end

  defp flatten_and_sum(nested_list) do
    List.flatten(nested_list)
  end

  defp combine_outputs(base_output, spline_output, combination_weights) do
    Enum.zip([base_output, spline_output, combination_weights])
    |> Enum.map(fn {base, spline, weight} ->
      weight * base + (1 - weight) * spline
    end)
  end

  defp update_metrics(metrics, latency, status) do
    total = metrics.total_requests + 1
    successful = if status == :success, do: metrics.successful_requests + 1, else: metrics.successful_requests
    failed = if status == :failure, do: metrics.failed_requests + 1, else: metrics.failed_requests
    
    # Exponential moving average for latency
    alpha = 0.1
    new_avg_latency = alpha * latency + (1 - alpha) * metrics.average_latency_us
    
    # Calculate throughput
    time_diff = DateTime.diff(DateTime.utc_now(), metrics.last_update, :second)
    throughput = if time_diff > 0, do: 1.0 / time_diff, else: metrics.throughput_per_sec
    
    %{
      total_requests: total,
      successful_requests: successful,
      failed_requests: failed,
      average_latency_us: new_avg_latency,
      last_update: DateTime.utc_now(),
      throughput_per_sec: throughput
    }
  end

  defp schedule_health_check do
    Process.send_after(self(), :health_check, 10_000)  # Every 10 seconds
  end

  defp perform_health_check(state) do
    Logger.debug("Health check for actor #{state.actor_id}: #{inspect(state.metrics)}")
    
    # Check if neighbors are alive
    alive_neighbors = Enum.filter(state.neighbors, &Process.alive?/1)

    end
    
    :ok
  end

  defp handle_neighbor_result(neighbor_id, result, state) do
    Logger.debug("Received result from neighbor #{neighbor_id}")
    # Process distributed computation result

  end

    def __init__(self, context: CompilationContext):
        self.context = context
        self.module = ir.Module(name="jaide_kan_module")
        self.builder = None
        self.function_cache: Dict[str, ir.Function] = {}
        
    def create_function(self, name: str, arg_types: List[ir.Type], 
                       return_type: ir.Type) -> ir.Function:
        """Creates a new function in the IR module."""
        if name in self.function_cache:
            return self.function_cache[name]
        
        func_type = ir.FunctionType(return_type, arg_types)
        func = ir.Function(self.module, func_type, name=name)
        self.function_cache[name] = func
        return func
    
    def build_spline_basis_evaluation(self) -> ir.Function:
        """Builds IR for B-spline basis evaluation (Cox-de Boor algorithm)."""
        float_type = ir.FloatType()
        ptr_type = ir.PointerType(float_type)
        
        # Function signature: float* spline_basis(float x, float* knots, int degree, int n)
        arg_types = [float_type, ptr_type, ir.IntType(32), ir.IntType(32)]
        func = self.create_function("spline_basis_eval", arg_types, ptr_type)
        
        entry_block = func.append_basic_block(name="entry")
        self.builder = ir.IRBuilder(entry_block)
        
        x, knots, degree, n = func.args
        
        # Allocate result array
        result_size = self.builder.sub(n, self.builder.add(degree, ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 1)))
        result = self.builder.alloca(float_type, size=result_size, name="basis_result")
        
        # Initialize basis functions (degree 0)
        with self.builder.goto_block(self.builder.append_basic_block("init_loop")):
            i = self.builder.phi(ir.IntType(32), name="i")
            i.add_incoming(ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 0), entry_block)
            
            # Check if x is in [knots[i], knots[i+1])
            knot_i = self.builder.load(self.builder.gep(knots, [i]))
            knot_i_plus_1 = self.builder.load(
                self.builder.gep(knots, [self.builder.add(i, ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 1))])
            )
            
            cond1 = self.builder.fcmp_ordered(">=", x, knot_i)
            cond2 = self.builder.fcmp_ordered("<", x, knot_i_plus_1)
            in_range = self.builder.and_(cond1, cond2)
            
            value = self.builder.select(in_range, 
                                       ir.Constant(float_type, 1.0),
                                       ir.Constant(float_type, 0.0))
            
            self.builder.store(value, self.builder.gep(result, [i]))
            
            # Increment and check loop condition
            i_next = self.builder.add(i, ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 1))
            i.add_incoming(i_next, self.builder.block)
            
            loop_cond = self.builder.icmp_signed("<", i_next, result_size)
            with self.builder.if_then(loop_cond):
                self.builder.branch(self.builder.block)
        
        # Cox-de Boor recursion
        d_loop = self.builder.append_basic_block("degree_loop")
        self.builder.branch(d_loop)
        
        with self.builder.goto_block(d_loop):
            d = self.builder.phi(ir.IntType(32), name="d")
            d.add_incoming(ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 1), entry_block)
            
            # Inner loop over basis functions
            # ... (recursion implementation)
            
        self.builder.ret(result)
        return func
    
    def build_kan_layer_forward(self, input_dim: int, output_dim: int, 
                                grid_size: int, degree: int) -> ir.Function:
        """Builds IR for complete KAN layer forward pass."""
        float_type = ir.FloatType()
        ptr_type = ir.PointerType(float_type)
        
        # Function signature: void kan_forward(float* input, float* output, float* weights)
        arg_types = [ptr_type, ptr_type, ptr_type]
        func = self.create_function("kan_layer_forward", arg_types, ir.VoidType())
        
        entry_block = func.append_basic_block(name="entry")
        self.builder = ir.IRBuilder(entry_block)
        
        input_ptr, output_ptr, weights_ptr = func.args
        
        # Outer loop: iterate over output dimensions
        out_loop = self.builder.append_basic_block("output_loop")
        self.builder.branch(out_loop)
        
        with self.builder.goto_block(out_loop):
            out_idx = self.builder.phi(ir.IntType(32), name="out_idx")
            out_idx.add_incoming(ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 0), entry_block)
            
            # Initialize accumulator
            acc = self.builder.alloca(float_type, name="accumulator")
            self.builder.store(ir.Constant(float_type, 0.0), acc)
            
            # Inner loop: iterate over input dimensions
            in_loop = self.builder.append_basic_block("input_loop")
            self.builder.branch(in_loop)
            
            with self.builder.goto_block(in_loop):
                in_idx = self.builder.phi(ir.IntType(32), name="in_idx")
                in_idx.add_incoming(ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 0), out_loop)
                
                # Load input value
                input_val = self.builder.load(self.builder.gep(input_ptr, [in_idx]))
                
                # Compute spline basis (call previously built function)
                spline_func = self.function_cache.get("spline_basis_eval")
                # ... (call spline basis evaluation)
                
                # Apply coefficients and accumulate
                # ... (coefficient application)
                
                # Increment input index
                in_idx_next = self.builder.add(in_idx, ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 1))
                in_idx.add_incoming(in_idx_next, in_loop)
                
                in_loop_cond = self.builder.icmp_signed("<", in_idx_next, 
                                                        ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), input_dim))
                end_in_loop = self.builder.append_basic_block("end_input_loop")
                self.builder.cbranch(in_loop_cond, in_loop, end_in_loop)
                
                with self.builder.goto_block(end_in_loop):
                    # Store accumulated result
                    result_val = self.builder.load(acc)
                    self.builder.store(result_val, self.builder.gep(output_ptr, [out_idx]))
                    
                    # Increment output index
                    out_idx_next = self.builder.add(out_idx, ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), 1))
                    out_idx.add_incoming(out_idx_next, end_in_loop)
                    
                    out_loop_cond = self.builder.icmp_signed("<", out_idx_next,
                                                            ir.Constant(ir.IntType(32), output_dim))
                    end_out_loop = self.builder.append_basic_block("end_output_loop")
                    self.builder.cbranch(out_loop_cond, out_loop, end_out_loop)
                    
                    with self.builder.goto_block(end_out_loop):
                        self.builder.ret_void()
        
        return func

    """Main JIT compiler for KAN operations."""
    
    def __init__(self, context: CompilationContext):
        self.context = context
        self.ir_builder = IRBuilder(context)
        self.llvm_module: Optional[llvm.ModuleRef] = None
        self.execution_engine: Optional[llvm.ExecutionEngine] = None
        self._initialize_llvm()
        
    def _initialize_llvm(self):
        """Initializes LLVM backend."""
        llvm.initialize()
        llvm.initialize_native_target()
        llvm.initialize_native_asmprinter()
        
        # Create target machine
        target = llvm.Target.from_default_triple()
        target_machine = target.create_target_machine(
            opt=self.context.optimization_level,
            features=",".join(self.context.target_features)
        )
        
        self.target_machine = target_machine
        
    def compile_function(self, func: Callable) -> Callable:
        """Compiles a Python function to native code."""
        # Extract function source and parse AST
        source = inspect.getsource(func)
        tree = ast.parse(source)
        
        # Build IR from AST
        self._build_ir_from_ast(tree)
        
        # Optimize IR
        self._optimize_ir()
        
        # Generate machine code
        native_func = self._generate_machine_code()
        
        return native_func
    
    def _build_ir_from_ast(self, tree: ast.AST):
        """Converts Python AST to LLVM IR."""
        visitor = ASTToIRVisitor(self.ir_builder)
        visitor.visit(tree)
        
    def _optimize_ir(self):
        """Applies optimization passes to IR."""
        llvm_ir = str(self.ir_builder.module)
        self.llvm_module = llvm.parse_assembly(llvm_ir)
        
        # Create pass manager
        pmb = llvm.create_pass_manager_builder()
        pmb.opt_level = self.context.optimization_level
        
        if self.context.enable_vectorization:
            pmb.loop_vectorize = True
            pmb.slp_vectorize = True
        
        pm = llvm.create_module_pass_manager()
        pmb.populate(pm)
        
        # Run optimization passes
        pm.run(self.llvm_module)
        
    def _generate_machine_code(self) -> Callable:
        """Generates executable machine code."""
        # Create execution engine
        target_machine = self.target_machine
        self.execution_engine = llvm.create_mcjit_compiler(
            self.llvm_module, target_machine
        )
        
        # Get function pointer
        func_name = "kan_layer_forward"
        func_ptr = self.execution_engine.get_function_address(func_name)
        
        # Create Python callable wrapper
        cfunc = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(None, 
                                ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),
                                ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),
                                ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float))(func_ptr)
        
        def wrapper(input_array: np.ndarray, weights: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            output = np.zeros(self.context.output_dim, dtype=np.float32)
            cfunc(input_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)),
                 output.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)),
                 weights.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)))
            return output
        
        return wrapper
    
    def compile_kan_layer(self, layer_config: Dict[str, Any]) -> Callable:
        """Compiles a complete KAN layer."""
        input_dim = layer_config['input_dim']
        output_dim = layer_config['output_dim']
        grid_size = layer_config['grid_size']
        degree = layer_config['spline_degree']
        
        # Build spline basis evaluation
        self.ir_builder.build_spline_basis_evaluation()
        
        # Build KAN layer forward pass
        self.ir_builder.build_kan_layer_forward(input_dim, output_dim, grid_size, degree)
        
        # Optimize and generate code
        self._optimize_ir()

class ASTToIRVisitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
    """Converts Python AST nodes to LLVM IR."""
    
    def __init__(self, ir_builder: IRBuilder):
        self.ir_builder = ir_builder
        self.current_function = None
        self.symbol_table: Dict[str, ir.Value] = {}
        
    def visit_FunctionDef(self, node: ast.FunctionDef):
        """Visits function definition."""
        # Extract argument types (would need type hints in practice)
        arg_types = [ir.FloatType() for _ in node.args.args]
        return_type = ir.FloatType()
        
        func = self.ir_builder.create_function(node.name, arg_types, return_type)
        self.current_function = func
        
        # Visit function body
        for stmt in node.body:
            self.visit(stmt)
            
    def visit_Return(self, node: ast.Return):
        """Visits return statement."""
        if node.value:
            value = self.visit(node.value)
            self.ir_builder.builder.ret(value)
        else:
            self.ir_builder.builder.ret_void()
            
    def visit_BinOp(self, node: ast.BinOp):
        """Visits binary operation."""
        left = self.visit(node.left)
        right = self.visit(node.right)
        
        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
            return self.ir_builder.builder.fadd(left, right)
        elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub):
            return self.ir_builder.builder.fsub(left, right)
        elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult):
            return self.ir_builder.builder.fmul(left, right)
        elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Div):
            return self.ir_builder.builder.fdiv(left, right)
        else:
            raise NotImplementedError(f"Binary operation {node.op} not supported")


def jit_compile(backend: str = "cpu", optimization_level: int = 3):
    """Decorator for JIT compilation of KAN operations."""
    def decorator(func: Callable) -> Callable:
        context = CompilationContext(
            backend=Backend(backend),
            optimization_level=optimization_level,
            target_features=["avx2", "fma"],
            precision="fp32",
            enable_fusion=True,
            enable_vectorization=True
        )
        
        compiler = KANJITCompiler(context)
        compiled_func = compiler.compile_function(func)
        
        return compiled_func
    return decorator

class BPETrainer:
    """Trains BPE vocabulary with morphological awareness."""
    
    def __init__(self, vocab_size: int, special_tokens: Dict[str, int]):
        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
        self.special_tokens = special_tokens
        self.vocab: Dict[str, int] = {}
        self.merges: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
        
    def train(self, corpus: List[str], morphology_analyzer: Optional[MorphologicalAnalyzer] = None) -> Tuple[Dict[str, int], List[Tuple[str, str]]]:
        """Trains BPE on the given corpus."""
        # Initialize vocabulary with special tokens
        self.vocab = self.special_tokens.copy()
        current_id = len(self.vocab)
        
        # Add all single characters
        char_freq = Counter()
        for text in corpus:
            char_freq.update(text)
        
        for char in sorted(char_freq.keys()):
            if char not in self.vocab:
                self.vocab[char] = current_id
                current_id += 1
        
        # Initialize word frequencies with character splits
        word_freqs = self._get_word_frequencies(corpus)
        splits = {word: list(word) for word in word_freqs.keys()}
        
        # Perform BPE merges
        while current_id < self.vocab_size:
            # Count pair frequencies
            pair_freqs = self._compute_pair_frequencies(splits, word_freqs)
            
            if not pair_freqs:
                break
            
            # Find most frequent pair
            best_pair = max(pair_freqs, key=pair_freqs.get)
            
            # Apply morphology bonus if available
            if morphology_analyzer:
                pair_freqs = self._apply_morphology_bonus(pair_freqs, morphology_analyzer)
                best_pair = max(pair_freqs, key=pair_freqs.get)
            
            # Merge the best pair
            splits = self._merge_pair(best_pair, splits)
            self.merges.append(best_pair)
            
            # Add to vocabulary
            merged_token = "".join(best_pair)
            self.vocab[merged_token] = current_id
            current_id += 1
            
            if current_id % 1000 == 0:
                print(f"Vocabulary size: {current_id}/{self.vocab_size}")
        
        return self.vocab, self.merges
    
    def _get_word_frequencies(self, corpus: List[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
        """Computes word frequencies in the corpus."""
        word_freqs = Counter()
        for text in corpus:
            # Simple whitespace tokenization
            words = text.split()
            word_freqs.update(words)
        return dict(word_freqs)
    
    def _compute_pair_frequencies(self, splits: Dict[str, List[str]], 
                                  word_freqs: Dict[str, int]) -> Dict[Tuple[str, str], int]:
        """Computes frequencies of adjacent character pairs."""
        pair_freqs = defaultdict(int)
        for word, freq in word_freqs.items():
            split = splits[word]
            if len(split) < 2:
                continue
            for i in range(len(split) - 1):
                pair = (split[i], split[i + 1])
                pair_freqs[pair] += freq
        return dict(pair_freqs)
    
    def _merge_pair(self, pair: Tuple[str, str], 
                   splits: Dict[str, List[str]]) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
        """Merges a character pair in all word splits."""
        new_splits = {}
        for word, split in splits.items():
            new_split = []
            i = 0
            while i < len(split):
                if i < len(split) - 1 and (split[i], split[i + 1]) == pair:
                    new_split.append(split[i] + split[i + 1])
                    i += 2
                else:
                    new_split.append(split[i])
                    i += 1
            new_splits[word] = new_split
        return new_splits
    
    def _apply_morphology_bonus(self, pair_freqs: Dict[Tuple[str, str], int],
                                analyzer: MorphologicalAnalyzer) -> Dict[Tuple[str, str], int]:
        """Applies frequency bonus to morphologically meaningful pairs."""
        bonused_freqs = pair_freqs.copy()
        
        for pair in pair_freqs.keys():
            merged = "".join(pair)
            
            # Check if merged token is a known morpheme
            analysis = analyzer.analyze(merged)
            
            # Bonus for roots, prefixes, and suffixes
            if analysis.root == merged or merged in analysis.prefixes or merged in analysis.suffixes:
                bonused_freqs[pair] = int(bonused_freqs[pair] * 1.5)
        
        return bonused_freqs

        # Train BPE
        self.vocab, self.merges = self.bpe_trainer.train(
            normalized_corpus,
            self.morphology_analyzer if self.config.morphology_enabled else None
        )
        
        # Create inverse vocabulary
        self.inverse_vocab = {v: k for k, v in self.vocab.items()}
        
    def load_from_file(self, vocab_path: str):
        """Loads tokenizer from saved vocabulary file."""
        with open(vocab_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        
        self.vocab = data['vocab']
        self.merges = [tuple(merge) for merge in data['merges']]
        self.inverse_vocab = {v: k for k, v in self.vocab.items()}
        
    def save_to_file(self, vocab_path: str):

        data = {
            'version': '2.1.0',
            'vocab_size': len(self.vocab),
            'vocab': self.vocab,
            'merges': self.merges,
            'config': {
                'normalization': self.config.normalization,
                'lowercase': self.config.lowercase,
                'morphology_enabled': self.config.morphology_enabled,
            }
        }
        
        with open(vocab_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    def _normalize_text(self, text: str) -> str:
        """Normalizes text according to configuration."""
        # Unicode normalization
        if self.config.normalization:
            text = unicodedata.normalize(self.config.normalization, text)
        
        # Lowercase
        if self.config.lowercase:
            text = text.lower()
        
        # Accent handling
        if self.config.accent_handling == "remove":
            text = ''.join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize('NFD', text)
                          if unicodedata.category(c) != 'Mn')
        
        return text
    
    def encode(self, text: str, add_special_tokens: bool = True) -> List[int]:
        """Encodes text to token IDs."""
        text = self._normalize_text(text)
        
        # Split into words
        words = self._split_text(text)
        
        # Tokenize each word
        token_ids = []
        
        if add_special_tokens and '<bos>' in self.vocab:
            token_ids.append(self.vocab['<bos>'])
        
        for word in words:
            # Morphological preprocessing
            if self.config.morphology_enabled:
                analysis = self.morphology_analyzer.analyze(word)
                # Encode morphemes separately if beneficial
                word_tokens = self._encode_word(word)
            else:
                word_tokens = self._encode_word(word)
            
            token_ids.extend(word_tokens)
        
        if add_special_tokens and '<eos>' in self.vocab:
            token_ids.append(self.vocab['<eos>'])
        
        return token_ids
    
    def decode(self, token_ids: List[int], skip_special_tokens: bool = True) -> str:
        """Decodes token IDs to text."""
        tokens = []
        
        for token_id in token_ids:
            if token_id not in self.inverse_vocab:
                if self.config.byte_fallback:
                    tokens.append('<unk>')
                continue
            
            token = self.inverse_vocab[token_id]
            
            # Skip special tokens if requested
            if skip_special_tokens and token in self.config.special_tokens:
                continue
            
            tokens.append(token)
        
        # Join tokens
        text = ''.join(tokens)
        
        # Post-processing
        text = text.replace('▁', ' ')  # Handle space marker if used
        
        return text.strip()
    
    def _split_text(self, text: str) -> List[str]:
        """Splits text into words and punctuation."""
        # Use regex to preserve punctuation
        pattern = r'\w+|[^\w\s]'
        return regex.findall(pattern, text)
    
    def _encode_word(self, word: str) -> List[int]:
        """Encodes a single word using BPE."""
        if word in self.vocab:
            return [self.vocab[word]]
        
        # Start with character-level split
        tokens = list(word)
        
        # Apply BPE merges
        for merge_pair in self.merges:
            new_tokens = []
            i = 0
            while i < len(tokens):
                if i < len(tokens) - 1 and (tokens[i], tokens[i + 1]) == merge_pair:
                    new_tokens.append(tokens[i] + tokens[i + 1])
                    i += 2
                else:
                    new_tokens.append(tokens[i])
                    i += 1
            tokens = new_tokens
        
        # Convert tokens to IDs
        token_ids = []
        for token in tokens:
            if token in self.vocab:
                token_ids.append(self.vocab[token])
            elif self.config.byte_fallback:
                # Byte-level fallback
                for byte in token.encode('utf-8'):
                    token_ids.append(byte + len(self.vocab))
            else:
                token_ids.append(self.vocab.get('<unk>', 1))
        
        return token_ids
    
    def tokenize(self, text: str) -> List[str]:
        """Tokenizes text into string tokens."""
        token_ids = self.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        return [self.inverse_vocab.get(tid, '<unk>') for tid in token_ids]
    
    def get_vocab_size(self) -> int:
        """Returns the vocabulary size."""
        return len(self.vocab)
    
    def batch_encode(self, texts: List[str], padding: bool = True, 
                    max_length: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        """Encodes a batch of texts."""
        encoded_batch = [self.encode(text) for text in texts]
        
        if max_length:
            encoded_batch = [seq[:max_length] for seq in encoded_batch]
        
        if padding:
            max_len = max(len(seq) for seq in encoded_batch)
            pad_id = self.vocab.get('<pad>', 0)
            
            padded_batch = []
            attention_masks = []
            
            for seq in encoded_batch:
                padding_length = max_len - len(seq)
                padded_seq = seq + [pad_id] * padding_length
                attention_mask = [1] * len(seq) + [0] * padding_length
                
                padded_batch.append(padded_seq)
                attention_masks.append(attention_mask)
            
            return {
                'input_ids': np.array(padded_batch, dtype=np.int64),
                'attention_mask': np.array(attention_masks, dtype=np.int64)
            }
        
        return {'input_ids': encoded_batch}

class FisherInformationMatrix:
    """Computes and maintains Fisher Information Matrix for natural gradients."""
    
    def __init__(self, model_params: Dict[str, np.ndarray]):
        self.params = model_params
        self.fisher_diagonal: Dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
        self.fisher_full: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
        self.damping = 1e-5
        
    def compute_diagonal_fisher(self, loss_fn: Callable, data_samples: List[Any]) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        """Computes diagonal approximation of Fisher Information Matrix."""
        # Initialize Fisher accumulator
        fisher_diag = {k: np.zeros_like(v) for k, v in self.params.items()}
        
        n_samples = len(data_samples)
        
        for sample in data_samples:
            # Compute gradients for this sample
            gradients = self._compute_sample_gradients(loss_fn, sample)
            
            # Accumulate squared gradients (diagonal Fisher approximation)
            for key in fisher_diag.keys():
                if key in gradients:
                    fisher_diag[key] += gradients[key] ** 2
        
        # Average over samples
        for key in fisher_diag.keys():
            fisher_diag[key] /= n_samples
            # Add damping for numerical stability
            fisher_diag[key] += self.damping
        
        self.fisher_diagonal = fisher_diag
        return fisher_diag
    
    def compute_full_fisher(self, loss_fn: Callable, data_samples: List[Any]) -> np.ndarray:
        """Computes full Fisher Information Matrix."""
        # Flatten all gradients into a single vector
        total_params = sum(v.size for v in self.params.values())
        fisher_matrix = np.zeros((total_params, total_params))
        
        n_samples = len(data_samples)
        
        for sample in data_samples:
            # Compute gradient vector
            grad_vector = self._flatten_gradients(
                self._compute_sample_gradients(loss_fn, sample)
            )
            
            # Outer product: g * g^T
            fisher_matrix += np.outer(grad_vector, grad_vector)
        
        # Average and add damping
        fisher_matrix /= n_samples
        fisher_matrix += np.eye(total_params) * self.damping
        
        self.fisher_full = fisher_matrix
        return fisher_matrix
    
    def natural_gradient(self, gradient: Dict[str, np.ndarray], 
                        use_full: bool = False) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        """Applies natural gradient transformation."""
        if use_full and self.fisher_full is not None:
            # Use full Fisher matrix
            flat_grad = self._flatten_gradients(gradient)
            fisher_inv = np.linalg.inv(self.fisher_full)
            natural_grad_flat = fisher_inv @ flat_grad
            return self._unflatten_gradients(natural_grad_flat)
        else:
            # Use diagonal approximation
            natural_grad = {}
            for key, grad in gradient.items():
                if key in self.fisher_diagonal:
                    natural_grad[key] = grad / np.sqrt(self.fisher_diagonal[key])
                else:
                    natural_grad[key] = grad
            return natural_grad
    
    def _compute_sample_gradients(self, loss_fn: Callable, sample: Any) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        """Computes gradients for a single sample."""
        # Numerical gradient computation
        gradients = {}
        epsilon = 1e-5
        
        for key, param in self.params.items():
            param_grad = np.zeros_like(param)
            
            # Compute gradient element-wise (can be optimized)
            it = np.nditer(param, flags=['multi_index'])
            while not it.finished:
                idx = it.multi_index
                
                # Forward difference
                original = param[idx]
                param[idx] = original + epsilon
                loss_plus = loss_fn(sample)
                param[idx] = original - epsilon
                loss_minus = loss_fn(sample)
                param[idx] = original
                
                param_grad[idx] = (loss_plus - loss_minus) / (2 * epsilon)
                it.iternext()
            
            gradients[key] = param_grad
        
        return gradients
    
    def _flatten_gradients(self, gradients: Dict[str, np.ndarray]) -> np.ndarray:
        """Flattens gradient dictionary into a single vector."""
        return np.concatenate([g.flatten() for g in gradients.values()])
    
    def _unflatten_gradients(self, flat_grad: np.ndarray) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        """Unflattens gradient vector back to dictionary."""
        gradients = {}
        offset = 0
        for key, param in self.params.items():
            size = param.size
            gradients[key] = flat_grad[offset:offset+size].reshape(param.shape)
            offset += size
        return gradients

    """Implements quantum annealing schedule for optimization."""
    
    def __init__(self, total_steps: int, schedule_type: str = "linear"):
        self.total_steps = total_steps
        self.schedule_type = schedule_type
        self.current_step = 0
        
    def get_temperature(self) -> float:
        """Returns current temperature for annealing."""
        progress = self.current_step / self.total_steps
        
        if self.schedule_type == "linear":
            return 1.0 - progress
        elif self.schedule_type == "exponential":
            return math.exp(-5 * progress)
        elif self.schedule_type == "inverse":
            return 1.0 / (1.0 + 10 * progress)
        elif self.schedule_type == "cosine":
            return 0.5 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress))
        else:
            return 1.0 - progress

        """Returns quantum tunneling probability."""
        temperature = self.get_temperature()
        if temperature < 1e-8:
            return 0.0
        return math.exp(-energy_barrier / temperature)

        self.current_step = min(self.current_step + 1, self.total_steps)

class BSplineBasis:
    """Implements B-spline basis functions using Cox-de Boor recursion."""
    
    def __init__(self, knots: np.ndarray, degree: int):
        self.knots = knots
        self.degree = degree
        self.num_bases = len(knots) - degree - 1
        
    def evaluate(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Evaluates all B-spline basis functions at given points."""
        # x shape: (batch_size,)
        # output shape: (batch_size, num_bases)
        
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        basis_values = np.zeros((batch_size, self.num_bases))
        
        # Cox-de Boor recursion
        # Start with degree 0 (indicator functions)
        prev_basis = self._evaluate_degree_0(x)
        
        # Recursively build up to desired degree
        for d in range(1, self.degree + 1):
            prev_basis = self._cox_de_boor_recursion(x, prev_basis, d)
        
        return prev_basis
    
    def _evaluate_degree_0(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Evaluates degree-0 basis (indicator functions)."""
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        basis = np.zeros((batch_size, self.num_bases))
        
        for i in range(self.num_bases):
            left = self.knots[i]
            right = self.knots[i + 1]
            basis[:, i] = ((x >= left) & (x < right)).astype(float)
        
        # Handle right boundary
        if self.num_bases > 0:
            basis[:, -1] = ((x >= self.knots[-2]) & (x <= self.knots[-1])).astype(float)
        
        return basis
    
    def _cox_de_boor_recursion(self, x: np.ndarray, prev_basis: np.ndarray, 
                               degree: int) -> np.ndarray:
        """Applies one step of Cox-de Boor recursion."""
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        num_bases_new = prev_basis.shape[1] - 1
        basis = np.zeros((batch_size, num_bases_new))
        
        for i in range(num_bases_new):
            # Left term
            left_knot = self.knots[i]
            right_knot = self.knots[i + degree]
            span = right_knot - left_knot
            
            if span > 1e-10:
                weight_left = (x - left_knot) / span
                basis[:, i] += weight_left * prev_basis[:, i]
            
            # Right term
            left_knot_next = self.knots[i + 1]
            right_knot_next = self.knots[i + degree + 1]
            span_next = right_knot_next - left_knot_next
            
            if span_next > 1e-10:
                weight_right = (right_knot_next - x) / span_next
                basis[:, i] += weight_right * prev_basis[:, i + 1]
        
        return basis
    
    def derivative(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Computes derivative of B-spline basis functions."""
        if self.degree == 0:
            return np.zeros((x.shape[0], self.num_bases))
        
        # Use derivative formula for B-splines
        deriv_basis = np.zeros((x.shape[0], self.num_bases))
        
        # Create lower-degree spline
        lower_degree_spline = BSplineBasis(self.knots, self.degree - 1)
        lower_basis = lower_degree_spline.evaluate(x)
        
        for i in range(self.num_bases):
            # First term
            span1 = self.knots[i + self.degree] - self.knots[i]
            if span1 > 1e-10:
                deriv_basis[:, i] += self.degree * lower_basis[:, i] / span1
            
            # Second term
            if i + 1 < lower_basis.shape[1]:
                span2 = self.knots[i + self.degree + 1] - self.knots[i + 1]
                if span2 > 1e-10:
                    deriv_basis[:, i] -= self.degree * lower_basis[:, i + 1] / span2
        
        return deriv_basis


class KANLayer:
    """Complete KAN layer with all features."""
    
    def __init__(self, config: KANLayerConfig):
        self.config = config
        
        # Initialize knot vectors
        self.knots = self._initialize_knots()
        
        # Create B-spline basis for each input dimension
        self.spline_bases = [
            BSplineBasis(self.knots, config.spline_degree)
            for _ in range(config.input_dim)
        ]
        
        # Initialize learnable parameters
        num_bases = self.spline_bases[0].num_bases
        
        # Spline coefficients: (input_dim, output_dim, num_bases)
        self.spline_weights = self._initialize_weights(
            (config.input_dim, config.output_dim, num_bases)
        )
        
        # Base function weights (for linear part)
        if config.use_base_activation:
            self.base_weights = self._initialize_weights(
                (config.input_dim, config.output_dim)
            )
        else:
            self.base_weights = None
        
        # Bias term
        self.bias = np.zeros(config.output_dim)
        
        # Layer normalization parameters
        if config.layer_norm:
            self.gamma = np.ones(config.output_dim)
            self.beta = np.zeros(config.output_dim)
        
        # Grid adaptation parameters
        if config.enable_adaptive_grid:
            self.grid_adaptation_momentum = 0.9
            self.grid_statistics = {
                'mean': np.zeros(config.input_dim),
                'std': np.ones(config.input_dim)
            }
        
        # Cache for backward pass
        self.cache: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        
    def _initialize_knots(self) -> np.ndarray:
        """Initializes knot vector for B-splines."""
        grid_min, grid_max = self.config.grid_range
        degree = self.config.spline_degree
        grid_size = self.config.grid_size
        
        # Uniform knot vector with extended boundaries
        interior_knots = np.linspace(grid_min, grid_max, grid_size)
        
        # Add repeated knots at boundaries for proper B-spline behavior
        knots = np.concatenate([
            np.repeat(grid_min, degree),
            interior_knots,
            np.repeat(grid_max, degree)
        ])
        
        return knots
    
    def _initialize_weights(self, shape: Tuple) -> np.ndarray:
        """Initializes weights using Xavier/Glorot initialization."""
        fan_in = shape[0] if len(shape) > 1 else 1
        fan_out = shape[1] if len(shape) > 1 else shape[0]
        
        # Xavier initialization
        limit = math.sqrt(6.0 / (fan_in + fan_out))
        return np.random.uniform(-limit, limit, shape)
    
    def forward(self, x: np.ndarray, training: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
        """Forward pass through KAN layer."""
        # x shape: (batch_size, input_dim)
        batch_size, input_dim = x.shape
        assert input_dim == self.config.input_dim
        
        # Store input for backward pass
        self.cache['input'] = x
        
        # Adapt grid if enabled
        if self.config.enable_adaptive_grid and training:
            self._update_grid_statistics(x)
        
        # Normalize input to grid range
        x_normalized = self._normalize_input(x)
        
        # Compute spline basis values for each input dimension
        spline_basis_values = []
        for i in range(input_dim):
            basis_vals = self.spline_bases[i].evaluate(x_normalized[:, i])
            spline_basis_values.append(basis_vals)
        
        # Stack: (batch_size, input_dim, num_bases)
        spline_basis = np.stack(spline_basis_values, axis=1)
        self.cache['spline_basis'] = spline_basis
        
        # Apply spline weights and sum over bases
        # spline_output shape: (batch_size, output_dim)
        spline_output = np.zeros((batch_size, self.config.output_dim))
        
        for i in range(input_dim):
            # basis: (batch_size, num_bases)
            # weights: (output_dim, num_bases)
            # contribution: (batch_size, output_dim)
            contribution = spline_basis[:, i, :] @ self.spline_weights[i].T
            spline_output += contribution
        
        # Base activation contribution
        if self.config.use_base_activation and self.base_weights is not None:
            x_activated = self._apply_activation(x)
            base_output = x_activated @ self.base_weights
            base_output *= self.config.base_activation_scale
            output = spline_output + base_output
            self.cache['base_output'] = base_output
            self.cache['x_activated'] = x_activated
        else:
            output = spline_output
        
        # Add bias
        output += self.bias
        
        # Layer normalization
        if self.config.layer_norm:
            output = self._layer_norm(output)
            self.cache['pre_norm_output'] = output
        
        # Dropout (only during training)
        if training and self.config.dropout_rate > 0:
            dropout_mask = (np.random.rand(*output.shape) > self.config.dropout_rate).astype(float)
            dropout_mask /= (1 - self.config.dropout_rate)  # Scale
            output *= dropout_mask
            self.cache['dropout_mask'] = dropout_mask
        
        # Residual connection
        if self.config.residual_connection and input_dim == self.config.output_dim:
            output += x
        
        self.cache['output'] = output
        return output
    
    def backward(self, grad_output: np.ndarray) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, Dict[str, np.ndarray]]:
        """Backward pass to compute gradients."""
        # grad_output shape: (batch_size, output_dim)
        
        # Residual gradient
        if self.config.residual_connection and self.config.input_dim == self.config.output_dim:
            grad_input_residual = grad_output.copy()
        else:
            grad_input_residual = 0
        
        # Dropout gradient
        if 'dropout_mask' in self.cache:
            grad_output = grad_output * self.cache['dropout_mask']
        
        # Layer norm gradient
        if self.config.layer_norm:
            grad_output = self._layer_norm_backward(grad_output)
        
        # Bias gradient
        grad_bias = np.sum(grad_output, axis=0)
        
        # Spline weights gradient
        grad_spline_weights = np.zeros_like(self.spline_weights)
        grad_input_spline = np.zeros_like(self.cache['input'])
        
        spline_basis = self.cache['spline_basis']
        batch_size = grad_output.shape[0]
        
        for i in range(self.config.input_dim):
            # Gradient w.r.t. spline weights
            # grad_output: (batch_size, output_dim)
            # spline_basis: (batch_size, num_bases)
            grad_spline_weights[i] = grad_output.T @ spline_basis[:, i, :]
            
            # Gradient w.r.t. input (through spline basis)
            # This requires derivative of spline basis
            spline_deriv = self.spline_bases[i].derivative(self.cache['input'][:, i])
            
            for j in range(self.config.output_dim):
                grad_input_spline[:, i] += (
                    grad_output[:, j:j+1] * 
                    (spline_deriv @ self.spline_weights[i, j, :])
                )
        
        # Base activation gradient
        if self.config.use_base_activation and self.base_weights is not None:
            grad_base_weights = self.cache['x_activated'].T @ grad_output
            grad_base_weights *= self.config.base_activation_scale
            
            # Gradient through activation
            grad_x_activated = grad_output @ self.base_weights.T
            grad_x_activated *= self.config.base_activation_scale
            grad_input_base = self._activation_backward(grad_x_activated, self.cache['input'])
        else:
            grad_base_weights = None
            grad_input_base = 0
        
        # Total input gradient
        grad_input = grad_input_spline + grad_input_base + grad_input_residual
        
        # Package gradients
        gradients = {
            'spline_weights': grad_spline_weights,
            'bias': grad_bias
        }
        
        if grad_base_weights is not None:
            gradients['base_weights'] = grad_base_weights
        
        if self.config.layer_norm:
            gradients['gamma'] = self.cache.get('grad_gamma', np.zeros_like(self.gamma))
            gradients['beta'] = self.cache.get('grad_beta', np.zeros_like(self.beta))
        
        return grad_input, gradients
    
    def _normalize_input(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Normalizes input to grid range."""
        if not self.config.enable_adaptive_grid:
            return x
        
        # Standardize using running statistics
        mean = self.grid_statistics['mean']
        std = self.grid_statistics['std']
        
        x_normalized = (x - mean) / (std + 1e-8)
        
        # Clip to grid range
        grid_min, grid_max = self.config.grid_range
        x_normalized = np.clip(x_normalized, grid_min, grid_max)
        
        return x_normalized
    
    def _update_grid_statistics(self, x: np.ndarray):
        """Updates running statistics for adaptive grid."""
        batch_mean = np.mean(x, axis=0)
        batch_std = np.std(x, axis=0)
        
        momentum = self.grid_adaptation_momentum
        
        self.grid_statistics['mean'] = (
            momentum * self.grid_statistics['mean'] + 
            (1 - momentum) * batch_mean
        )
        
        self.grid_statistics['std'] = (
            momentum * self.grid_statistics['std'] + 
            (1 - momentum) * batch_std
        )
    
    def _apply_activation(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Applies base activation function."""
        if self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.SILU:
            return x / (1 + np.exp(-x))
        elif self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.GELU:
            return 0.5 * x * (1 + np.tanh(math.sqrt(2/math.pi) * (x + 0.044715 * x**3)))
        elif self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.RELU:
            return np.maximum(0, x)
        elif self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.TANH:
            return np.tanh(x)
        elif self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.SIGMOID:
            return 1 / (1 + np.exp(-x))
        else:
            return x
    
    def _activation_backward(self, grad: np.ndarray, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Computes gradient through activation function."""
        if self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.SILU:
            sigmoid = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-x))
            return grad * (sigmoid * (1 + x * (1 - sigmoid)))
        elif self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.RELU:
            return grad * (x > 0)
        elif self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.TANH:
            return grad * (1 - np.tanh(x)**2)
        elif self.config.base_activation == ActivationType.SIGMOID:
            sigmoid = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-x))
            return grad * (sigmoid * (1 - sigmoid))
        else:
            return grad
    
    def _layer_norm(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Applies layer normalization."""
        mean = np.mean(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        var = np.var(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        
        x_normalized = (x - mean) / np.sqrt(var + 1e-8)
        
        self.cache['norm_mean'] = mean
        self.cache['norm_var'] = var
        self.cache['norm_input'] = x
        
        return self.gamma * x_normalized + self.beta
    
    def _layer_norm_backward(self, grad: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Computes gradient through layer normalization."""
        x = self.cache['norm_input']
        mean = self.cache['norm_mean']
        var = self.cache['norm_var']
        
        x_normalized = (x - mean) / np.sqrt(var + 1e-8)
        
        # Gradient w.r.t. gamma and beta
        self.cache['grad_gamma'] = np.sum(grad * x_normalized, axis=0)
        self.cache['grad_beta'] = np.sum(grad, axis=0)
        
        # Gradient w.r.t. input
        N = x.shape[-1]
        grad_normalized = grad * self.gamma
        
        grad_var = np.sum(grad_normalized * (x - mean) * -0.5 * (var + 1e-8)**(-1.5), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        grad_mean = np.sum(grad_normalized * -1 / np.sqrt(var + 1e-8), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        grad_mean += grad_var * np.sum(-2 * (x - mean), axis=-1, keepdims=True) / N
        
        grad_input = grad_normalized / np.sqrt(var + 1e-8)
        grad_input += grad_var * 2 * (x - mean) / N
        grad_input += grad_mean / N
        
        return grad_input
    
    def update_parameters(self, gradients: Dict[str, np.ndarray], learning_rate: float):
        """Updates layer parameters with gradients."""
        self.spline_weights -= learning_rate * gradients['spline_weights']
        self.bias -= learning_rate * gradients['bias']
        
        if 'base_weights' in gradients and self.base_weights is not None:
            self.base_weights -= learning_rate * gradients['base_weights']
        
        if self.config.layer_norm:
            self.gamma -= learning_rate * gradients.get('gamma', 0)
            self.beta -= learning_rate * gradients.get('beta', 0)
    
    def get_parameters(self) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        """Returns all trainable parameters."""
        params = {
            'spline_weights': self.spline_weights,
            'bias': self.bias
        }
        
        if self.base_weights is not None:
            params['base_weights'] = self.base_weights
        
        if self.config.layer_norm:
            params['gamma'] = self.gamma
            params['beta'] = self.beta
        
        return params
